newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Thousands of refugee breach Tanzanian army cordon.
newsitem.headline: Thousands of refugee breach Tanzanian army cordon.

text.p: Thousands of Rwandan refugees breached a Tanzanian army cordon and flooded back into a camp in northwest Tanzania on Friday after thousands crossed into Rwanda.
An official of the U.N. refugee agency estimated some 5,000 refugees had crossed into Rwanda and up to 300,000 were on the road heading back to the camps they had fled since last Sunday.

"The dam burst and thousands are pouring back into Benaco camp," said Reuters correspondent David Fox. "The soldiers beat quite a lot of them with sticks but once it became clear they could not turn back the tide they just stood and watched."
The UNHCR official, who declined to be identified, said his estimates were very rough but he believed some 5,000 had crossed the border on Friday into Rwanda which they fled in 1994.
He said 300,000 Rwandan and Burundian refugees were on roads heading back towards their camps which they had fled since Sunday before troops and police turned them around at roadblocks on Friday.

The refugees abandoned their camps and trekked away from the Rwandan border, saying they believed they were about to be expelled by Tanzania as part of a campaign to send home all 540,000 Rwandan refugees in northwest Tanzania by December 31.
